marker_outcome.sim_grasp_note: Sim marker is never lifted: at the recorded grasp (jaw closes ~line 640) the recorded joints put the jaw tips ~5 mm from the marker in xy but ~40 mm above the table, while the real grasp needs the tips at ~10-15 mm to straddle a 15 mm marker. Arm servo replay is the deliverable; the wrist-pitch/tip-height gap is a twin-vs-real modeling residual.
